title.narrative: Getting Results: Access and Delivery of Quality Education Services in Balochistan

description.narrative: The objective of the Getting Results: Access and Delivery of Quality Education Services in Balochistan Project is to increase girls and boys enrollment in pre-primary and primary grades, and improve reading and numeracy proficiency in primary grades, all in project-supported schools. There are four components to the project, the first component being getting results agenda. This component supports Balochistan's education reform agenda with interventions that will improve access to and quality of education in ECE and primary levels and lay a strong foundation for lifelong learning and holistic development of children. The second component is the expand access to education. This component includes three subcomponents: climate-smart classrooms for a sustainable expansion of the school system, strengthen parental engagement, and safe and affordable school journeys for girls. The third component is technical assistance, evaluation and project implementation. This component will fund support for the project implementation, monitoring, including third party monitoring, management and communication, supervision and monitoring of environmental and social requirements, and development of a capacity building plan with annual implementation targets. Finally, the fourth component is the contingent emergency response component.
